text:
Forget the script. Throw out the "shoulds" and "supposed tos". Those are just dusty relics of someone else's journey. This is YOUR chapter. Write it wild, write it weird, write it YOUR way.

Don't be afraid to be a beginner again. Embrace the awkwardness, the fumbles, the "I don't know how". It's fertile ground for growth and discovery.

Listen to that little voice inside that whispers "What if...?" Don't silence it. Let it lead you down unexpected paths.  

Don't be afraid to fail. Failure is not the opposite of success, it's a stepping stone on the path towards it. Learn from the stumbles, dust yourself off, and keep going.

Surround yourself with people who inspire you to think differently, who challenge your assumptions, who celebrate your audacity.

Remember, this is your story. Make it epic. Make it yours.  

Now go out there and break some rules.
